name: Protect Object
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECTS

Range touch
Target touched object or structure with a volume of up to 10 cu. ft./level
Duration 10 min./level (or concentration if targeting a structure)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like resist energy, except that it affects an object instead of a creature. Protect object does not provide additional protection to creatures or objects inside or behind the affected object. A shield protected from fire damage provides no additional protection to its wielder, and a building protected from acid does nothing extra to keep acid from getting to those inside. If a protected town is attacked, the caster of this spell may choose to protect a single building instead of participating in combat. If that building is damaged in the attack, ignore the result. If the building is destroyed, treat it as only damaged.
